description: A semicircular zone gauge for Power BI — show a value within configurable danger, warning, and success zones, ideal for operational dashboards where a quick visual read of "is this OK?" is more important than the exact number. Codex Zone Gauge replaces the standard Power BI gauge with a zone-coloured semicircle that uses position and colour to communicate status, not a needle in space. New in v2: background transparency to sit over any report canvas and conditional-formatting (fx) rules on zone and marker colours. IDEAL FOR Operational health monitoring Service level dashboards (zone = SLA tier) Performance dashboards with red / amber / green logic Scoreboard tiles where the read is "in the green" or "in the red" Replacing speedometer-style gauges with a more honest, more compact alternative KEY FEATURES Configurable zone breakpoints and colours (danger / warning / success) Optional needle marker showing current position Configurable background, label, and value styling Smooth animated transitions on update (respects prefers-reduced-motion) Full font controls on every text element Optional internal title with full font and alignment controls Hover tooltip showing value, zone, and zone thresholds Click to cross-filter other visuals Background colour with 0–100% transparency — sits cleanly on any report canvas Conditional formatting (fx) on zone and marker colours — drive…
